page.layout: Title "INDEX" centred at the top; below it two columns of index entries. Left column runs down the page past the lower edge of the scan. Right column is shorter, beside the upper part of the left column, and ends partway down the scan.; Two printed columns: on the left, one partly visible line at the foot; on the right, a narrow column of italic index entries with page references, running from the top of the scan to the catchword at the foot.

main_text.head: INDEX
main_text.l: Forma ut educatur è potentia materia igno-
Forma quomodo, à quo, & ex quo fiat facilè
Forma à quo fiat ex Aristotele, ejus sententia
Ex iis veritas contraria copiose illustratur 122
sit singulis compositis diversa insit necesse est

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "materia" (line 6) may be "materiæ"; "ætatibus" (right column) is read from a faint letter; "interëunte" has a diaeresis that may be a printing blur. Last line of the left column is cut by the lower edge of the scan, so its end is missing. The left column is almost entirely cut off; only its last line is visible at the foot, so the transcription of the left page is incomplete. Uncertain readings: "ctionem" (line 231 continuation) and the reference "233, 234" beside "pathia", where the separator looks like a comma or a figure 1. The bullet after "adnatum cum" is not a letter and is omitted. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout, and the signature is read as "S s 3".
